from pathlib import Path
program_dir=Path('/home/ubuntu/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/runs/adhoc-primeagentlearner-1792485207/attempts/aebe2cf00e3243528294ba8447492ab6/system/state/workspace/programs')
program_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
code='''def transform(grid):
    # Each nonzero color forms one object; crop each object and concatenate left to right by input position.
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    colors = sorted({v for row in grid for v in row if v != 0}, key=lambda c: min(j for row in grid for j, v in enumerate(row) if v == c))
    tiles = []
    for color in colors:
        cells = [(i, j) for i, row in enumerate(grid) for j, v in enumerate(row) if v == color]
        r0, r1 = min(i for i, j in cells), max(i for i, j in cells)
        c0, c1 = min(j for i, j in cells), max(j for i, j in cells)
        tiles.append([[grid[i][j] for j in range(c0, c1 + 1)] for i in range(r0, r1 + 1)])
    out_h = max(len(tile) for tile in tiles)
    out_w = sum(len(tile[0]) for tile in tiles)
    out = [[0] * out_w for _ in range(out_h)]
    x = 0
    for tile in tiles:
        for i, row in enumerate(tile):
            out[i][x:x + len(row)] = row
        x += len(tile[0])
    return out
'''
path=program_dir/'task-a1b417f4.py'
path.write_text(code)
exec(compile(code,str(path),'exec'),globals())

expected=[[0,2,0,0,3,0,0,8,0],[2,2,2,3,3,3,8,8,8],[0,2,0,0,3,0,0,8,0]]
